target_api_desc_used.description: I need to retrieve futures trades that match a particular contract expiration type—like weekly or quarterly—and possibly filter by the contract's delivery date, while still controlling the market, pair, time range, sorting, and result size.

required_parameters.name: market_venue
required_parameters.description: The name of the exchange or venue. Example: BINANCE.

required_parameters.name: base
required_parameters.description: The second listed currency of a currency pair. Example: USDT.

required_parameters.name: symbol
required_parameters.description: The first listed currency of a currency pair. Example: BTC.

optional_parameters.name: sort
optional_parameters.description: The ordering of results. Available options: asc (earliest to latest), desc (latest to earliest).

optional_parameters.name: start
optional_parameters.description: Start of the requested time period. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS UTC.

optional_parameters.name: end
optional_parameters.description: End of the requested time period. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS UTC.

optional_parameters.name: limit
optional_parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return. Maximum value is 10000.

optional_parameters.name: expiration
optional_parameters.description: The lifespan of a futures contract. Available options: perpetual, weekly, quarterly, monthly.

optional_parameters.name: delivery_date
optional_parameters.description: The last day when a future contract is valid. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
